title: Homemakers Building Safety and Stability
description: Across Bangladesh, women like Nondo, Gayitri, and Ratna are holding families together through care, resilience, and leadership. Supported by AzuKo, they strengthen their homes, manage savings groups, and share practical knowledge to protect their families from climate risks and uncertainty.

title: Bake to Build: Pathways to Home Improvement Fundraiser
description: Bake to Build is a festive fundraising event supporting AzuKo’s Pathways to Home Improvement programme. By hosting a bake sale, individuals and communities help women in rural Bangladesh build climate-resilient homes—while early donations can be doubled through the Big Give campaign.

title: Dignity Can’t Wait: Sanitation Beyond the Missed Targets and build climate resilient toilets
description: As the 2030 SDG deadline approaches, millions still lack safe sanitation. AzuKo highlights how women-led, climate-resilient sanitation solutions are essential for dignity, education, and health—showing that investing in sanitation is not charity, but justice.
